schedule: 5 alternating-order pairs per each of 4 manifest-pinned fixtures, 40 total fresh-process samples
comparison: Frozen main default-off vs candidate opt-in; existing runtime identity statement retained
memory: Existing perfMem per-phase and peak JS/WASM/geometry counters; not physical browser RSS
output: Per-arm mesh counts; CPU hashing excluded from timings

cachePolicy: Fresh browser process/profile each sample; OS file cache uncontrolled; fixture/model first load in each browser
scope: Historical recorded source, not a benchmark of the removal PR
reproducerChange: The executable reproducer aggregates sample and cohort errors outside finally, retaining both primary and cleanup failures. The measured driver is archived verbatim; all accepted samples had no errors and cleanupError=null. No new timing samples were run.
